evals.name: no-server-names-both-supported-setups
evals.expected_output: Checks Dometrain tool availability by server segment and tool name, not a fixed prefix, without inspecting the token, settings, or environment variables. When neither resolves, names the two supported setups (install dometrain-mcp, or add a user-scope dometrain server per the README) and requires a reload before rechecking.
expectations: Never reads settings, environment variables, credential storage, logs, or the API key
Matches Dometrain tools by server segment and tool name in the runtime inventory, not a fixed full prefix
Names both supported setups: install dometrain-mcp, or add a user-scope dometrain server per the README
Warns that installing dometrain-mcp next to a user-scope server at the same URL produces a duplicate-server warning
Distinguishes no server present from a configured server whose tools do not resolve
Never claims to read '/mcp' connection status directly — reports tool-inventory / ToolSearch signals only
Requires reload-plugins or a new session after configuration

evals.name: already-enabled-server-is-reported-reachable
evals.prompt: /dometrain:setup — mcp__dometrain__search_dometrain already appears in my tool list (my own user-scope server).
evals.expected_output: Treats the user-scope tools as present, reports connected as a user-scope server, and does not open the native plugin prompt or inspect the API key, settings, or environment.
expectations: Reports connected as a user-scope server and does not ask for dometrain-mcp
Reports the server as reachable from tool inventory, not from reading the key
Does not prompt to re-enter or rotate the API key
Never reads settings, environment variables, or credential storage

evals.name: auth-error-routes-to-native-prompt-not-key-inspection
evals.prompt: /dometrain:setup — search_dometrain just failed with an authentication error. Fix the key.
evals.expected_output: Does not open settings, logs, or the environment to look at the key. For a dometrain-mcp key, routes reconfiguration through Claude Code's native plugin prompt for dometrain-mcp; for a user-scope server, points to claude mcp list and the README. Requires reload-plugins or a new session before rechecking.
expectations: Never reads or prints the API key
Routes a dometrain-mcp key through /plugin configure dometrain-mcp and a user-scope server through claude mcp list and the README
Requires a reload or new session before claiming the error is gone
